title: CrossNode-Bench: claim-vs-truth evidence for AI agents
description:
CrossNode-Bench measures whether an AI agent tells the truth about completed work. For each task the harness records the agent's claim, an independent probe on the target node, and a verdict; claim success plus truth failure is a false success.

Public artifact: 12,344 claim-vs-truth records from 36 runs on 6 heterogeneous nodes, with 53 false successes (0.43%). All false successes are probes. A controlled run of 25,600 planted-liar trials gives 6.25% share of probes that were planted liars; this is not a field rate.

This deposit contains the specification (v1.2.2), the LUMI MI250X false-success guard results (19.7% raw → 0/1,000 PASS; the 10k rerun on 2026-11-04 was 1/10,000, FAIL — the earlier 0/10,000 was not reproduced), the harness, the public JSONL, a SHA-256 hash chain with a Merkle root, an offline verifier, JSON schemas, an OPA gate, and a keyless cosign + in-toto CI workflow. Verifying the artifact does not require this deposit: the chain and manifest are public and the verifier is offline.

v1.4.0 adds a real multi-region fleet run: 25,600 honest records (100% pass, 0 false-success) on 9 nodes (Contabo + 8 Vultr), and a controlled liar run (28,800 records, 400 false-successes, all 400 flagged). The liar is a MockLiar wrapper; this is a detection test, not a field rate.

What this deposit does not claim: no field false-success rate from the controlled test, no hardware root of trust, no Sigstore public transparency anchor, and no peer review.
